reviews.title: Harnais solide, confortable et sécurisant pour mon Shiba
reviews.body:
J’ai acheté ce harnais Ruffwear Avant pour mon Shiba, connu pour être un petit expert de la fuite 😅.
✅ Points positifs : le harnais tient très bien, il est vraiment anti-fuite, sans être étouffant ni gênant. Le tissu est respirant et léger, ce qui le rend confortable même lors des longues promenades. Les sangles sont faciles à ajuster et le design est à la fois sobre et élégant.
🧠 Mon avis global : c’est un excellent harnais pour les chiens vifs ou craintifs. Mon Shiba s’y est très vite habitué et je me sens rassurée lors des balades.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Francia el 22 de octubre de 2025

reviews.title: This Is A Beautifully Made Harness.
reviews.body:
The first impression of this harness when opening the package is that it is a beautifully made item. The materials are all of the best quality and there is not a stitch out of place. My dog is a Miniature Schnauzer, so there isn't going to be a powerful dog wearing it in my case, but I have no doubt whatsoever that the larger sizes will be more than up to controlling heavy, strong dogs.
It is adjustable in multiple places and it was easy to make it fit my dog. The sizing of the harness is precisely in line with the measurements quoted in the size chart, so if you have accurately measured your dog and bought the size that covers that figure, this will fit.
All the edges and surfaces are nicely finished and I have no doubt that my dog finds wearing the harness to be really comfortable. The reflective details are a good touch. the twin points of closure make the harness very simple to put on. This is in contrast to his old harness; my daughter always struggled to get the dog into the old one and that wasn't entirely down to her being short on common sense.
Yes, it is expensive compared to its competitors, and the question must be whether it is worth the extra. For me, the answer is that it is. The quality is so good that I can see this outlasting the dog and he is only two years old. My philosophy is 'buy once, cry once', so I purchase things of quality instead of buying cheap items that need to be replaced a couple of times. This harness did not disappoint me in any way.
reviews.date: Reseñado en el Reino Unido el 25 de septiembre de 2024
